summaryFr: L’éveil standard 3★→4★ consomme exactement 6 ramen du même élément au total : 1 ramen de base et 5 matériaux. Il coûte500 ryō et transforme204 000 EXP de base en220 000 (+16 000 ; +7,84%). Pour un personnage du même élément :306 000→330 000 (+24 000). Les éveils1★→2★ et2★→3★ coûtent200 ryō et consomment chacun3 ramen source au total.

awakeningRecipeRule.degId: 0 for all standard ramen; it is not the awakening target.

awakeningCoinRule.formula: 100 × Unit.GetMaxLevel(selectedCharaData) × number of positive recipe material IDs
awakeningCoinRule.arithmetic: 32-bit integer multiplication; no floating-point rounding in the inspected formula.

levelCondition.proof: Native normal-awakening gate compares selectedCharaData.level with Unit.GetMaxLevel(index0). All standard ramen source and target parameter ranges are1..1.
levelCondition.afterLevelScope: Template metadata establishes target range1..1. No live server response or awakening action was performed.

experienceRule.perItemRounding: Native ceiling after material-level/element arithmetic. All tested level1 standard ramen outputs are exact integers.
experienceRule.multiplierScope: Campaign EXP and success boosts, when supplied by an actual scenario/result, multiply feeding EXP; they do not change the deterministic awakening recipe or getEvolveCost.
experienceRule.comparisonAssumption: Both choices use the same feeding EXP scenario. Random outcomes of separate feeding actions are not assumed identical.
experienceRule.wasteCautionFr: Le gain reste utile seulement si le personnage a besoin de cette EXP : le dépassement du plafond ne devient pas une ressource récupérable.

fullChain1To4.scope: Derived by composing the three verified recipes; not an additional native recipe.

stockMappingNote.note: The recipe creates Ichiraku Ramen XXL12714, not Mechanical Ramen15854. A category stock may group both for EXP because both have Wisdom attribute and220 000 base EXP.

otherItemsScope: The type3=90 category also contains5 treasure chests with150 000 EXP and one Mechanical Ramen with220 000. They have no awakening recipe in the copied table. The standard ladder covers20 Ichiraku Ramen forms.

nativeEvidence.awakeningRouteEvidence: ExternalData.EvolveStart calls Unit.CanBattle; non-battle materials use NetworkManager.CharaAwakeMaterial. No network method was called in this audit.
nativeEvidence.validationScope: Native Unit.GetRecipe/GetSozaiUnitId, GetMaxLevel/GetParamData, IsEvoMixEnabled and ExternalData.getEvolveCost execute offline against copied ramen data. The final level/material/coin branch of GetCharaEvolveMaterialState (0x234cefc onward) is exercised with the independently verified cost and source level cap supplied. The single-item arithmetic branch of ExternalData.get_getMixAddExp (0x22caa0c..0x22cacb8), including Unit.IsMaterialUnit and ceiling conversion, executes for each standard ramen with same/different elements. Managed list allocation/ToArray/indexing, selected-character and Unit providers, coin provider, and the inventory-existence result are local stubs. Obfuscated integer constants are decrypted with copied local client keys. The full GetCharaEvolveMaterialState method/dispatch and EXP enumeration are not claimed emulated. No NetworkManager/awakening request or game action is executed.

limitations: Copied client code and master data establish recipe and displayed costs; no server awakening response was captured.
Stocks, current campaigns and random success results remain unknown unless entered by the user.
Native inventory lookup is stubbed as present/absent in boundary tests; exact recipe multiplicities are independently established from copied UnitList and native GetRecipe.
